The finite checker exhaustively confirms the base statement for \(3\le n\le10\) and the block arithmetic for \(1\le m\le6\); these computations are explicitly secondary to the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The source explicitly asks for explicit tests for dihedral groups. This theorem supplies a closed necessary-and-sufficient divisibility test for every finite ambient group when the multiset is supported on two involutions, generalizing the known \(S_3\) and \(D_8\) two-letter cases and structurally explaining Aliabadi's multiplicity obstruction via a Cayley-cycle perfect-matching argument. It is an infinite-family structural lemma, not an arbitrary finite computation.
